hero.eyebrow: Cinematic edge motion · living canvas grain
hero.description: Symmetric top and bottom glass edges with smooth inertial scrolling, velocity response, layered parallax and living 35mm film grain that jitters 1px per frame.

blur.title: BLUR
blur.description: The fixed edge layers stay visually transparent while adapting their blur and glow to the movement of the page – now with fluid 0.09 lerp.

gradient.title: GRADIENT
gradient.description: The gradient is strongest at each viewport boundary and softens toward the content, mirrored from top to bottom. Grain weaves with gate weave.

fade.title: FADE
fade.description: The masks remove the glass progressively, so there is no hard lower or upper panel edge while the parallax keeps depth alive. Canvas grain at half-res – 6 textures swapping every 2 frames.

card.label: Effect stack
card.value: inertia → velocity → parallax → glass edge → living grain

footer.primary: AIO HTML · symmetric edge glass / smooth inertia / velocity parallax
footer.secondary: LIVE GRAIN · 24FPS JITTER · canvas half-res · 6 textures · 1px jitter · gate weave · 35mm sparse
